sub_graphs.title: EIP-7768: No-Ether Transaction Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of transactions from zero-balance accounts using the free-for-all tip mechanism

nodes.label: User Account Has Zero Ether
nodes.description: EOA has no Ether but wants to submit transactions to the network

nodes.label: User Signs Transaction Batch
nodes.description: User cryptographically signs desired transactions with properly ordered nonces

nodes.label: Transaction Batch Signed
nodes.description: Complete batch of signed transactions ready for submission to block proposer services

nodes.label: Submit to Block Proposer Service
nodes.description: User transmits transaction series to services communicating with block proposers

nodes.label: Transaction Pending Proposer Evaluation
nodes.description: Transaction batch awaiting evaluation by block proposer

nodes.label: Proposer Creates Ether Funding Transaction
nodes.description: Block proposer creates a transaction sending Ether to user based on gas price times block size

nodes.label: User Account Temporarily Funded
nodes.description: User account has received Ether from proposer to cover gas costs

nodes.label: Execute User Transactions
nodes.description: Execute all user transactions in the prepared context

nodes.label: User Transactions Executed
nodes.description: All user transactions have been executed in the context

nodes.label: Identify Consideration to Free-For-All
nodes.description: Identify tokens transferred to the free-for-all contract as payment

nodes.label: Consideration Amount Identified
nodes.description: Proposer has identified value of tokens sent to free-for-all bucket

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter (Zero-Balance EOA)
external_entities.description: External user with an EOA that has no Ether but wants to submit transactions

external_entities.name: Block Proposer
external_entities.description: Entity that evaluates and includes transactions in blocks, provides temporary Ether funding

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7768: Block Proposer Evaluation Framework
sub_graphs.description: Models the 8-step evaluation process used by block proposers to validate and accept no-ether transactions

nodes.label: Execution Context Created
nodes.description: Proposer has established execution context including Ether-send and user transactions

nodes.label: Simulate First Execution Run
nodes.description: Execute context to identify consideration and measure gas consumption

nodes.label: First Simulation Complete
nodes.description: First execution run complete with gas usage and consideration identified

nodes.label: Sign Consideration Extraction Transaction
nodes.description: Proposer signs transaction to extract tokens from free-for-all account

nodes.label: Extraction Transaction Signed
nodes.description: Transaction for extracting consideration is prepared and signed

nodes.label: Calculate Total Gas Expenditure
nodes.description: Sum up total gas costs for all transactions in the context

nodes.label: Gas Expenditure Calculated
nodes.description: Total gas costs are known for cost-benefit analysis

nodes.label: Rollback and Re-Execute with Actual Gas
nodes.description: Rollback context and re-execute steps 1-4 using actual required gas amounts

nodes.label: Second Simulation Complete
nodes.description: Second execution run complete with corrected gas amounts

nodes.label: Verify Consideration Matches
nodes.description: Abort if received consideration differs from first iteration

nodes.label: Consideration Verified Consistent
nodes.description: Consideration is consistent between both runs

nodes.label: Apply Local Business Logic
nodes.description: Compare Ether spent vs consideration received according to local policy

nodes.label: Evaluation Favorable
nodes.description: Business logic determines transaction is profitable for proposer

nodes.label: Evaluation Unfavorable
nodes.description: Business logic determines transaction is not profitable

nodes.label: Commit Context to Chain
nodes.description: Include favorable transaction batch in the block

nodes.label: Rollback and Reject
nodes.description: Discard unfavorable transaction batch

nodes.label: Transaction Batch Included in Block
nodes.description: Transactions are committed to the blockchain

nodes.label: Transaction Batch Rejected
nodes.description: Transactions were not included due to unfavorable economics

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7768: Free-For-All Bucket Contract Interface
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundary and interactions with the well-known free-for-all bucket contract

nodes.label: Free-For-All Contract Deployed
nodes.description: Well-known free-for-all bucket contract is deployed at known address

nodes.label: Receive Token Transfer
nodes.description: Contract receives ERC-20, ERC-721, or ERC-1155 tokens as consideration payment

nodes.label: Tokens Received in Bucket
nodes.description: Tokens have been transferred to the free-for-all bucket contract

nodes.label: Execute Withdrawal Call
nodes.description: Proposer calls execute() to withdraw tokens to recipient address

nodes.label: Tokens Withdrawn by Proposer
nodes.description: Proposer has extracted consideration tokens from the bucket

nodes.label: Preload Executions
nodes.description: Proposer optionally preloads responses for the free-for-all account

nodes.label: Preloaded Responses Set
nodes.description: Preloaded execution responses are configured for the block

nodes.label: Fallback Function Triggered
nodes.description: Contract fallback function handles unexpected calls

external_entities.name: User Transaction
external_entities.description: Transaction from user that transfers tokens to the free-for-all bucket as payment

external_entities.name: Block Proposer
external_entities.description: Block proposer who extracts consideration from the free-for-all bucket

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define the exact address of the 'well-known free-for-all bucket contract'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the contract address will be specified in a future update or deployment, and must be a pre-determined constant known to all participants.

ambiguities.text: The term 'valuable consideration' is used without precise definition of what constitutes value
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume consideration includes ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155 tokens as explicitly mentioned, and possibly native Ether. The proposer determines value according to local business logic.

ambiguities.text: The specification mentions 'order transaction nonces accounting for partial execution scenarios' but does not specify the exact ordering strategy
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume users must order nonces sequentially and handle cases where only some transactions execute, with payment proportional to successful executions.

ambiguities.text: Security considerations are noted as 'incomplete in the document'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Treat this as a draft specification with significant security analysis still required before production use.

implicit_assumptions.description: The block proposer is trusted to honestly execute the evaluation framework and not manipulate the execution context to steal consideration
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Proposer could front-run user transactions, extract consideration without including user transactions, or manipulate execution to favor themselves.

implicit_assumptions.description: Services communicating with block proposers are available and willing to relay no-ether transactions
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users would have no way to submit transactions, making the system unusable.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot predict the exact gas cost in a way that allows them to provide just enough consideration to be included but not enough to make proposer profitable
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Griefing attacks where proposers lose money on transactions they evaluate but ultimately find unprofitable.

implicit_assumptions.description: The free-for-all contract correctly implements the specified interface and cannot be exploited to drain tokens
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Tokens deposited as consideration could be stolen by anyone, not just the intended block proposer.
